        activeSince
        completesOn

        lastActivityDate
        accountInvestmentId
        sourceRefId
        initialInvestmentAmount
        targetAmount
        goalType
        performanceSummary {
          trackedAt
          reportingCurrency
          investedValue
          holdingAmount
          balanceAmount
          currentValue
          withdrawnValue
